title: Aquemi equipment: EMI skids, P-40, P-80, dosing tank, portable CIP and AeroWell | Aquemi
meta: Aquemi water equipment: EMI, the modular Purified Water skid system, and standard items with a fixed datasheet: the P-40 and P-80, a dosing tank and the AeroWell atmospheric water generator.
eyebrow: EQUIPMENT · WATER FOR INDUSTRY · ON SITE · FROM AIR
headline: Water equipment, from a skid system to a cart
lead: EMI, our modular Purified Water system, is engineered to your requirements. The rest is standard equipment: one design, one datasheet, built to order. The P-40, P-80, dosing tank, portable CIP and AeroWell.

blocks.intro: EMI is sized and configured per project. Each standard item is one fixed design with its own datasheet; the first units are built to order, with a longer lead time while we complete the design.

items.d: Pretreatment, reverse osmosis, electrodeionization and storage and distribution skids that share one control panel. Take the skids your water needs.
Hose in, hose out, no power. Sediment, carbon, one 4040 RO element and mixed-bed DI on a wheeled frame, for rinse, fill and top-up water.
[P-80: what it is, in one line]. In design; datasheet to follow.
[Dosing tank: what it is, in one line]. In design; datasheet to follow.
[Portable CIP: what it is, in one line]. Clean-in-place (CIP) on wheels. In design; datasheet to follow.
Drinking water from the air: 9 US gal (34 L) a day at 26 °C and 60 % humidity, on a 120 V outlet.

blocks.intro: Both come from the same shop. What differs is who sets the design.
rows: Your user requirement specification (URS) and feed water
Purified Water, designed to meet USP <645> and <643>
Low-mineral or drinking water; not a pharmacopoeial grade
Design, fabrication, test and qualification records
Factory acceptance test with water, witnessed; IQ, OQ and PQ

items.q: Can the standard equipment make Purified Water for a GMP plant?
items.a: No. Products are not designed or certified for pharmaceutical, dialysis or laboratory water grades. That is EMI's job.

items.q: Who is the standard equipment for?
items.a: Trades, light industry, mobile and off-grid users: rinse, fill, top-up and drinking water where no plant exists.

Send the enquiry form with the item's name. We confirm price, lead time and freight in writing. The first units of each are built to order, with a longer lead time while we complete the design. EMI starts with a proposal.

cta.body: Tell us the item and where it will work. An engineer replies in writing with price and lead time. For EMI, send your water data instead.
